implementation_checks: Existing lock probe uses no-follow/nonblocking regular-file open and validates opened identity; FIFO/symlink replacement must not block or acquire an unrelated lock.
No cache lock is held over I/O; cached status stays responsive during blocked probe.
Probe never refreshes semantic success timestamp; recent same-PID semantic success is explicitly observed readiness, not model availability.
One actual worker retains permit and CALLS guard after response timeout; no new writer or late stale observation.
